description.value: The berserker gains a bite attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of damage (if the berserker is Medium; 1d3 if the berserker is Small) plus the berserker's Strength modifier. If made as part of a full-attack action with manufactured weapons, the bite attack is made at the berserker's full base attack bonus – 5, and he adds only 1/2 his Strength modifier to the damage roll. The berserker can make a bite attack as part of the action to maintain or break free from a grapple. If the bite attack hits, grapple checks attempted by the berserker against the target until the end of the round gain a +2 bonus.
